messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look at the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023 (based on the federal holidays that fall on or near a weekend).  
(If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can add the provincial holidays that create extra long weekends.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | 1 Jan was a Sunday; the holiday was observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, AB, NB, PEI, SK) | 20 Feb was a Monday; the weekend before (18–19) plus the holiday gives a 3‑day break. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | 7 Apr was a Friday; the holiday itself plus the weekend (8–9) creates a 3‑day stretch. |
| **May 23–25** | Victoria Day | 25 May was a Monday; the weekend before (23–24) plus the holiday gives a 3‑day break. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | 1 Jul was a Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday Jul 3, giving a 3‑day weekend (1–3). |
| **Sep 1–4** | Labour Day (observed Sep 4) | 1 Sep was a Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday Sep 4, giving a 4‑day weekend (1–4). |
| **Oct 8–10** | Thanksgiving | 10 Oct was a Monday; the weekend before (8–9) plus the holiday gives a 3‑day break. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | 11 Nov was a Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday Nov 13, giving a 3‑day weekend (11–13). |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | 25 Dec was a Monday; the weekend before (23–24) plus the holiday gives a 3‑day break. |

### Quick Summary

- **3‑day long weekends**: Jan 1–2, Feb 18–20, Apr 7–9, May 23–25, Jul 1–3, Oct 8–10, Nov 11–13, Dec 23–25  
- **4‑day long weekend**: Sep 1–4 (Labour Day)

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app, and let me know if you’d like provincial variations or additional details!
